high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "science.thewire.in." The content discusses a study by Woyciechowski and his colleagues who conducted a rigorous test to predict the extent of risk-taking behavior in bees. The text explains that they built a mathematical model to predict this behavior not as a function of age but of life expectancy. Key points from the text: The model was designed to test predictions about how life expectancy influences risk-taking.
